snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

requirements.rule: Title at most 20 words
requirements.quote: The title should be no more than 20 words

requirements.rule: Abstract at most 200 words
requirements.quote: The abstract should be no more than 200 words

requirements.rule: Abstract is unstructured, with no references or figures
requirements.quote: Please do not include any references or figures in your Abstract.

requirements.rule: Main text at most 4,500 words, not counting Abstract, Methods, References and figure legends
requirements.quote: The main text should be no more than 4,500 words

requirements.rule: Up to 6 keywords
requirements.quote: We allow the use of up to 6 keywords/key phrases

requirements.rule: Suggested structure: Introduction, Results (with subheadings), Discussion (without subheadings), Methods
requirements.quote: The following structure will be suitable in many cases:

requirements.rule: At most 8 display items (figures and tables together)
requirements.quote: Display items are limited to 8

requirements.rule: Figure legends at most 350 words each, starting with a brief title sentence
requirements.quote: Please begin your figure legends with a brief title sentence for the whole figure

requirements.rule: About 60 references at most (not strictly enforced)
requirements.quote: limited to 60 references, though not strictly enforced

requirements.rule: No footnotes
requirements.quote: Please note, footnotes should not be used.

requirements.rule: Line and page numbers are encouraged
requirements.quote: Please consider including those in your manuscript

requirements.rule: At first submission, figures may be in the manuscript file (up to 3 MB) or grouped at the end
requirements.quote: you may incorporate the manuscript text and figures into a single file up to 3 MB in size

requirements.rule: Author Contribution Statement is included
requirements.quote: You must supply an Author Contribution Statement

requirements.rule: Data Availability Statement is included
requirements.quote: You must include a Data Availability Statement in all submitted manuscripts

requirements.rule: Competing interests statement is included, under Additional Information
requirements.quote: Additional Information (including a Competing Interests Statement)

requirements.rule: Supplementary items are numbered like "Supplementary Table S1"
requirements.quote: Number Supplementary Tables and Figures as, for example, "Supplementary Table S1"

requirements.rule: Supplementary information is one separate file, preferably PDF, at most 50 MB
requirements.quote: Supplementary information should be combined and supplied as a single separate file, preferably in PDF format.

requirements.rule: Numbered citations in square brackets, per the journal's CSL style
Final figures: line art in vector format (EPS or AI), images at 300 dpi if possible, each complete figure as one file
requirements.quote: All digitized images submitted with the final revision of the manuscript should be 300 DPI if possible

requirements.rule: Affiliations in numerical order, each with city and country
requirements.quote: Affiliations must be listed in numerical order (1,2,7, not 7,2,1).

requirements.rule: Cover letter states any prior discussions with a Scientific Reports Editor
requirements.quote: whether you have had any prior discussions with a Scientific Reports Editor
